title: Chef John’s Spicy Shrimp Cakes
description: Chef John’s recipe for Asian-inspired spicy shrimp cakes uses chopped shrimp, chili paste, garlic, and spices coated with a crispy, golden panko crust.
ingredients: 2 pounds raw peeled and deveined shrimp
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves and stems
1 tablespoon finely crushed garlic, or to taste
1 teaspoon sambal chili paste, or more to taste
0.75 teaspoon kosher salt, or as desired
1 cup panko bread crumbs, or more if needed

steps.text: Combine shrimp, cilantro, garlic, chili paste, brown sugar, salt, fish sauce, turmeric, and cayenne pepper in the bowl of a food processor; pulse until mixture begins to break down. Scrape down sides of the bowl. Continue processing until mixture is very smooth but not puréed and moves around the bowl as a mass; transfer to a mixing bowl. Cover with plastic wrap; press wrap against surface of shrimp mixture. Refrigerate until chilled, 1 to 2 hours.
Place panko on a plate. Scoop out 8 equal-sized portions of shrimp mixture; roll in panko to coat. Shape into thin patties.

Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp cakes, in batches; cook until golden brown and cakes spring back to the touch, about 2 minutes per side. Drain on paper towels. Repeat with remaining cakes.

video.description: Full of sweet, heat and salt, the shrimp in these cakes is suffused with garlic, brown sugar, fish sauce, cilantro, chili sauce, cayenne and salt—that’s it! Once you’ve processed all the shrimp and flavors until it’s a fairly smooth paste, chill and roll in panko bread crumbs. Once you’ve formed your shrimp cakes, fry ‘em so good for a couple minutes on each side until golden and beautiful.
